statement: For either signed Collatz odd-return coefficient operator, every level r>=1, every nonnegative weight h periodic modulo 3^r, zero on multiples of three and positive at residue -s, and every d>=0, define U_0=h and U_(d+1)=max(h,L_s U_d). The envelope U_d is attained by a bounded inverse-tree policy and dominates every policy of depth at most d, including separate history-dependent choices on every branch. Some unit residue modulo 3^(r+d+1) satisfies L_s U_d<h; consequently every policy forced to expand first and stop by depth d+1 has homogeneous payoff below h at every positive integer representative of that residue. All admissible positive halving exponents are included. This does not provide a single deficient integer for all horizons, concern unbounded stopping, identify the payoff with actual reciprocal mass, or settle coefficient-series divergence. Kernel-checked; independent review and advisory statement coverage pending.
